title: Stable Morse lower bound for Hamiltonian fixed points
exact_target: For every closed connected symplectic manifold M and every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism $\varphi $ with all fixed points nondegenerate, must $\#Fix(\varphi )\geq SM(M)$? Here SM(M) is the minimum number of critical points of Morse functions on $M×R^k$ that agree outside a compact set with a nondegenerate quadratic form in the $R^k$ variables, minimized over $k\geq 0$.
